hero.badge: Built on official data · no ads
hero.titleLead: Know what your car will cost you next month.
hero.subtitle: For everyday drivers of 4-to-15-year-old cars. Add your plate, scan a fuel receipt, and Velocewealth shows your real cost per km, the repairs coming up, and where fuel is cheapest near you.

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.subtitle: Three things owners of older cars say they are fed up with. Three things the app is built to end.
pains.fuelBody: You know the price at the pump, not what a week of driving really costs. Scan the receipt: the app computes your true consumption, your cost per km, and finds the cheapest station in a 5 km radius from official price feeds.
pains.repairBody: A €900 bill you did not see coming is the worst kind. The app reads the official records for your exact car — MOT failures and advisories in the UK, safety recalls and owner complaints from the US database — and tells you what is likely to fail next and roughly what it costs.
pains.resaleBody: Every service you log is hash-chained and locked in the database. When you sell, export a certified PDF dossier a buyer can verify — and get a better price for a car you looked after.

howItWorks.title: Three steps. Five minutes.
howItWorks.subtitle: No OBD dongle, no app on your dashboard. Your plate and your receipts are enough.
howItWorks.step1Description: UK and French plates, or any 17-character VIN. We identify make, model, engine and year — and, in the UK, pull the full MOT history with every advisory ever written.
howItWorks.step2Description: Photograph fuel receipts and garage invoices. OCR fills the form; you check and save. Three scans a month free, unlimited on Pro.
howItWorks.step3Description: Real cost per km, a 12-month maintenance budget, alerts before the MOT and before parts wear out — and the cheapest fuel around you.

data.title: Official data, not guesses
data.subtitle: We only show what a public authority has recorded about your car or your model. When a source does not exist for your country, we say so.
data.worldNote: Manual entry, model-level recalls where the US database covers your model, local pricing.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Never. Revenue comes from Pro subscriptions, the one-off sale dossier, and referral commissions when you choose to buy a part or compare insurance through a link we show. No ad trackers. Data is stored in the EU.
faq.q2: Is the certified dossier legally binding?
faq.a2: It is technical proof, not a notarised act: each entry is signed with a SHA-256 hash chained to the previous one, and edits are blocked at the database level. A buyer can verify nothing was altered after the fact.
faq.a3: Yes. No commitment. Cancel in one click from Settings → Subscription via the Stripe portal; you keep Pro until the end of the period.
faq.a4: The app works anywhere with local pricing. Official per-car history is available in the UK (MOT), recalls and complaints come from the US database and cover many global models, and live fuel prices are available in France and Germany today. More sources are added as we find open ones.
faq.q5: Does it work for electric and hybrid cars?
faq.a5: Yes. Charging sessions are tracked like fuel, service intervals are adapted (no oil changes, longer brake life), and the energy mix is computed automatically.
faq.q6: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
faq.a6: Free: one car, three scans a month, cost per km and reminders. Pro: unlimited cars and scans, the full maintenance forecast, known-fault alerts for your model, the certified dossier, and tax-ready exports. Prices are adapted to your country.
